result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few horizontally clipped and obscured elements make the layout look slightly broken on mobile.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the lower restaurant card, hiding its image and likely its title/details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content, or ensure the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge, showing only part of the next chip.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly intentional horizontal carousel with scroll affordance, or constrain the row and provide a visible fade/arrow indicator.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” restaurant card and its title are clipped at the right edge of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Confirm the horizontal carousel behavior and add a visible partial-card affordance or adjust card sizing and spacing to make the overflow feel intentional.
